_notes: Real ALMA data: PLCK_G244.8+54.9 ('the Ruby', PJ105353), CO(7-6) at z = 3.005, 201.4 GHz.
The dataset is the pyuvimage test export (8 x 46.5 km/s channels, 81k visibilities, DATA column, not continuum-subtracted).
Caveats for interpreting the fit, not for running it:
- the source is a strongly lensed Einstein ring ~1.6 arcsec across; pyuvkin has no lens model, so a disc is only a morphological stand-in;
- the ~37 mJy continuum is still in the data (mstransform used douvcontsub=False);
- the 8 channels cover v = -18..+308 km/s about the line, i.e. only the red half (the CASA mom1 spans -440..+640 km/s).
For a real kinematic test, re-export the full 12 km/s window (~/Work/ALMA_PASSAGES/Ruby_CO7-6_CI/Ruby_CO7-6_12kms.ms.tar)
after uvcontsub, with casa_export.py inside CASA, then point 'dataset' at that .npz and set velocity_window_kms to [-600, 700].
Paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by pyuvkin.
_image_centre_note: ring centre in [dRA, dDec] arcsec from the phase centre; checked on the dirty image (CASA mom0 peak is at dRA +2.1, dDec -2.8)
